name: Enhanced Brown Mold OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
description: This unassuming fungus leeches heat out of the air.
disable: DC 22 Survival (trained) to safely remove the mold
reset: After expanding, the brown mold can't grow again for 1 day.

generalAbilities.name: Emit Cold
generalAbilities.description: 5 feet. Enhanced brown mold deals (1d10+6) Cold Damage damage to nearby creatures.

generalAbilities.name: Leech Warmth
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger Fire comes within 5 feet of the brown mold.

Effect The brown mold expands into every square adjacent to its space. As it grows, it pulls more heat from its surroundings, dealing (2d10+13) Cold Damage damage (Basic DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw save) to creatures within 10 feet after it expands.
